V = pi 15^2 10 + pi 10^2 30 - the groove 2 pi int_0^T (int int r dA of the section within the shaft) dt (2439.158513; a straight screw sweep, Pappus turn by turn, with the free end's partial turn integrated). 025 and 026 differ by where the groove stops
